name: Imouto no Himitsu
source:
The protagonist and his little sister attend a certain private school.
After school, they find themselves alone together.
Usually it's the same old boring days... but recently...

"Oniichan, I'm going home early," she says.
Something is strange about her.
The protagonist decides to follow her and discovers everything.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ074873.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角和他的妹妹在一所私立学校上学。
放学后，他们发现自己独自一人在一起。
通常都是同样无聊的日子…但最近…

“Oniichan，我要早点回家，”她说。
她有些奇怪。
主角决定跟随她并发现一切。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ074873.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
